name: Gasthof Maierhof
beschreibung: The Gasthof Maierhof is located in the community of Westendorf in the Tyrolean Unterland. The building blends effortlessly into the traditional architectural charm of the village. The inn's culinary philosophy places strong emphasis on fresh, locally sourced ingredients. Guest rooms are simply and functionally designed. Surrounded by gentle valleys and impressive peaks, the landscape around Westendorf invites leisurely walks and hikes. In winter, guests enjoy quick access to nearby ski slopes and cross-country trails. The property includes visitor parking and an inviting guest garden. A stay at Maierhof is defined by peaceful relaxation and closeness to nature.
